subtopics.title: The Code: four themes and person-centred decisions
subtopics.blurb: Know the Code's four themes and 25 standards, and use them to make person-centred decisions, including conscientious objection.

subtopics.title: Registration, revalidation and indemnity
subtopics.blurb: Know every revalidation requirement, the numbers behind them, and what to declare to the NMC and when.

subtopics.title: The duty of candour
subtopics.blurb: Tell apart the professional and statutory duties of candour and know exactly how to be open when care goes wrong.

subtopics.title: Raising and escalating concerns
subtopics.blurb: Know when and how to raise a concern, the NMC's four stages, and the protection whistleblowers have.

subtopics.title: Professional boundaries, gifts and social media
subtopics.blurb: Keep clear boundaries with patients and families, handle gifts and loans correctly and use social media safely.

subtopics.title: Equality, diversity and challenging discrimination
subtopics.blurb: Name the nine protected characteristics, spot each type of discrimination, make reasonable adjustments and challenge discriminatory behaviour.

subtopics.title: Own wellbeing, resilience and emotional intelligence
subtopics.blurb: Recognise when you or a colleague is struggling, act to keep patients and staff safe, and build resilience for practice.

subtopics.title: Evidence-based practice, research and critical thinking
subtopics.blurb: Rank evidence, tell research from audit and service evaluation, and apply guidance with professional judgement.

subtopics.title: Record keeping, digital and numeracy skills
subtopics.blurb: Write records that are contemporaneous, accurate, attributable and secure, on paper and on screen.

subtopics.title: Core communication skills
subtopics.blurb: Listen actively, read cues, choose open or closed questions well and check understanding every time.

subtopics.title: Accessible information, sensory impairment and interpreters
subtopics.blurb: Apply the Accessible Information Standard, support people with sensory impairment and use interpreters safely.

subtopics.title: Information, partnership and shared decision making
subtopics.blurb: Share information about conditions and treatments clearly, explain risks well and make decisions with people, not for them.

subtopics.title: Difficult conversations and emotional distress
subtopics.blurb: Break bad news, respond to distress and handle anger or complaints with compassion and honesty.

subtopics.title: Therapeutic interventions
subtopics.blurb: Recognise the nine therapeutic approaches in Annexe A and choose the right one for the person in front of you.

subtopics.title: Handover, reports and structured communication
subtopics.blurb: Use SBAR, give clear handovers and delegation instructions, and share digital information safely.

subtopics.title: Law, regulation, governance and human rights
subtopics.blurb: Tell statute from case law and guidance, know who regulates whom across the UK, and apply human rights and mandatory reporting duties.

subtopics.title: Valid consent and refusal
subtopics.blurb: Check that consent is voluntary, informed and given with capacity, and respond correctly when someone refuses or withdraws.

subtopics.title: Mental Capacity Act: principles and assessing capacity
subtopics.blurb: Apply the five MCA principles and the decision-specific capacity test, including fluctuating capacity and age limits.

subtopics.title: Best interests, LPAs, advance decisions and advocacy
subtopics.blurb: Make best interests decisions with the s4 checklist, and know when an LPA, an advance decision or an IMCA changes who decides.

subtopics.title: Deprivation of liberty, restraint and restrictive practice
subtopics.blurb: Use the least restrictive option, apply the MCA conditions for restraint, and know how DoLS authorisations work.

subtopics.title: Confidentiality, data protection and information sharing
subtopics.blurb: Protect confidential information, share it when care or safety requires, and apply the Caldicott and UK GDPR principles.

subtopics.title: Safeguarding adults and children
subtopics.blurb: Recognise the types of abuse, apply the Care Act s42 criteria and six principles, and share information to protect children.

subtopics.title: Recognising self-harm and suicidal ideation
subtopics.blurb: Ask about suicide directly and kindly, focus on needs and immediate safety rather than risk scores, and build a safety plan with the person.

subtopics.title: Person-centred holistic assessment across the lifespan
subtopics.blurb: Assess physical, psychological and social needs in partnership with the person, compare against their baseline and spot atypical presentations.

subtopics.title: Vital signs, temperature and body measurements
subtopics.blurb: Take, check and interpret observations, temperature and BMI, and know when a device reading cannot be trusted.

subtopics.title: Systems assessment, neurological observations and chest auscultation
subtopics.blurb: Score the GCS correctly, know when neurological observations demand urgent review, and interpret what you hear in the chest.

subtopics.title: Assessing mental state, cognition and distress
subtopics.blurb: Spot people at risk of delirium, use the 4AT, recognise hypoactive delirium and respond to distress, anxiety and agitation safely.

subtopics.title: Venepuncture, blood results and ECGs
subtopics.blurb: Take blood samples that give true results, act promptly on abnormal bloods, and record a 12-lead ECG correctly.

subtopics.title: Blood glucose and specimen collection
subtopics.blurb: Measure capillary glucose accurately, treat hypoglycaemia step by step, and collect and interpret urine, stool, sputum and vomit specimens.

subtopics.title: Care planning, comorbidity, evaluation and referral
subtopics.blurb: Turn an assessment into a person-centred plan with agreed goals, prioritise when someone has several conditions, evaluate honestly and refer safely.

subtopics.title: ABCDE assessment of the acutely unwell person
subtopics.blurb: Assess and treat a deteriorating person systematically, fixing each life-threatening problem before moving on and calling for help early.

subtopics.title: NEWS2, escalation and Martha's Rule
subtopics.blurb: Score NEWS2 accurately, match the score to the right response and monitoring frequency, escalate with SBAR, and know how Martha's Rule works.

subtopics.title: Sepsis in people aged 16 and over
subtopics.blurb: Use NICE NG253 to grade sepsis risk from NEWS2, deliver the high-risk bundle within the hour, give 250 mL fluid boluses and know the medium and low risk pathways.

subtopics.title: Oxygen therapy and respiratory care
subtopics.blurb: Give oxygen to a prescribed target with the right device, avoid the traps of pulse oximetry, and manage nebulisers, peak flow and breathlessness safely.

subtopics.title: Adult basic life support and in-hospital cardiac arrest
subtopics.blurb: Recognise cardiac arrest, call for help, give high-quality CPR and use an AED to RCUK 2025 standards, in the community and in hospital.

subtopics.title: Anaphylaxis
subtopics.blurb: Recognise anaphylaxis, give the right IM adrenaline dose into the thigh, repeat it at 5 minutes, and manage fluids, refractory reactions, observation and follow-up.

subtopics.title: Choking, seizures and physical first aid
subtopics.blurb: Act fast and in the right order for choking, seizures, chest pain, low glucose, bleeding, burns and opioid overdose.

subtopics.title: Mental health first aid and behaviour that challenges
subtopics.blurb: Respond to acute distress, de-escalate safely and know when (and how) restrictive interventions may be used.

subtopics.title: Dignity, privacy, comfort, rest and sleep
subtopics.blurb: Deliver the fundamentals of care with dignity and privacy, and protect comfort, rest and sleep in hospital.

subtopics.title: Pain assessment and management
subtopics.blurb: Assess pain with the right tool (including when people cannot tell you), relieve it, reassess and escalate.

subtopics.title: Pressure ulcer prevention and categorisation
subtopics.blurb: Assess risk, check skin (including darker skin tones), prevent pressure damage and categorise ulcers correctly.

subtopics.title: Personal hygiene, skin, mouth, eye and nail care
subtopics.blurb: Help people wash, dress and care for mouth, skin, eyes and nails while promoting independence, and know when to refer.

subtopics.title: Wound care and drains
subtopics.blurb: Assess wounds, spot infection, dress surgical wounds to NICE NG125 and manage drains, vacuum dressings and leg ulcers safely.

subtopics.title: Nutrition screening and support
subtopics.blurb: Screen with 'MUST', recognise malnutrition and refeeding risk, and help people eat and drink safely.

subtopics.title: Hydration, fluid balance and IV fluids
subtopics.blurb: Keep an accurate fluid balance, spot dehydration and overload, and apply NICE CG174 to IV fluid therapy and pumps.

subtopics.title: Nausea, vomiting, NG tubes and artificial nutrition
subtopics.blurb: Confirm nasogastric tube position safely before every use, run enteral and parenteral feeds safely and manage nausea and vomiting.

subtopics.title: Bladder, bowel, catheter and stoma care
subtopics.blurb: Support continence, care for urinary catheters to NICE standards, manage constipation, diarrhoea and retention, and look after stomas.

subtopics.title: Mobility, moving and handling, falls and VTE
subtopics.blurb: Assess and reduce falls risk to NICE NG249, move people safely with the right equipment, respond to a fall and prevent VTE.

subtopics.title: Standard precautions and hand hygiene
subtopics.blurb: Apply the 10 standard infection control precautions to every person, and choose the right hand hygiene at the right moment.

subtopics.title: Personal protective equipment
subtopics.blurb: Choose PPE by assessing the exposure risk, and put it on and take it off in the right order.

subtopics.title: Transmission-based precautions and isolation
subtopics.blurb: Match contact, droplet and airborne precautions to the organism, and decide who gets the single room.

subtopics.title: Aseptic technique and invasive devices
subtopics.blurb: Protect Key-Parts and Key-Sites with aseptic non-touch technique, and care for cannulas and urinary catheters to prevent infection.

subtopics.title: Sharps, waste, linen, spillages and decontamination
subtopics.blurb: Handle sharps safely, respond to a sharps injury, choose the right waste stream and deal with spills, linen and equipment.

subtopics.title: Antimicrobial stewardship and communicable disease surveillance
subtopics.blurb: Support safe antimicrobial use under NICE NG15, take the right samples at the right time, and know when infections must be notified or escalated.

subtopics.title: Medicines law, prescriptions and directions
subtopics.blurb: Know the legal categories of medicines and the lawful routes for giving them: prescriptions, PSDs, PGDs and the rare verbal order.

subtopics.title: Safe administration, checks, records and calculations
subtopics.blurb: Carry out the RPS/RCN checks before every dose, calculate safely, record what was given, withheld or refused, and support self-administration.

subtopics.title: Controlled drugs and safe storage
subtopics.blurb: Place common drugs in the right Misuse of Drugs Regulations schedule, keep the CD register correctly, and store, check and dispose of medicines safely.

subtopics.title: Routes, injections and vascular access
subtopics.blurb: Give IM, subcutaneous and intradermal injections with the right angle and site, and give medicines safely through cannulas and enteral tubes.

subtopics.title: Pharmacology, adverse reactions and polypharmacy
subtopics.blurb: Recognise side effects, allergies and interactions, report suspected reactions on Yellow Card, and support medication review in polypharmacy.

subtopics.title: High-risk medicines and medication errors
subtopics.blurb: Give insulin, anticoagulants, opioids, potassium and methotrexate safely, and respond openly when a medication error happens.

subtopics.title: Covert administration and altering medicines
subtopics.blurb: Know when hiding a medicine in food or drink is lawful, who must agree, and why crushing needs a pharmacist first.

subtopics.title: Blood component transfusion
subtopics.blurb: Give blood components safely: identify the patient, time the observations, spot a reaction early and act on it.

subtopics.title: Recognising dying and the Priorities for Care
subtopics.blurb: Recognise when someone may be entering the last days of life, review it daily and plan care around the five Priorities.

subtopics.title: Symptom control and hydration in the last days of life
subtopics.blurb: Manage pain, breathlessness, nausea, agitation and secretions in the last days, and handle mouth care and hydration well.

subtopics.title: Advance care planning, ReSPECT and DNACPR
subtopics.blurb: Tell apart advance statements, ADRTs, LPAs, ReSPECT plans and DNACPR decisions, and know which ones bind you.

subtopics.title: Verification of death and care after death
subtopics.blurb: Verify an expected adult death correctly, give dignified personal care after death and know when the coroner must be involved.

subtopics.title: Bereavement support and organ donation
subtopics.blurb: Support families around a death and apply UK opt-out organ donation law, including when to involve the specialist nurse.

subtopics.title: Principles of health promotion, protection and prevention
subtopics.blurb: Classify prevention as primary, secondary or tertiary, pick the right health promotion approach and empower people's own choices.

subtopics.title: Determinants of health, inequalities and epidemiology
subtopics.blurb: Explain what shapes health beyond healthcare, how inequalities are tackled, and read incidence and prevalence correctly.

subtopics.title: Making Every Contact Count and behaviour change
subtopics.blurb: Use routine contacts for brief health conversations: smoking VBA, alcohol units, activity, and matching support to motivation.

subtopics.title: National screening programmes
subtopics.blurb: Explain what screening can and cannot do, what a screen-positive result means, and who is offered which NHS programme in England.

subtopics.title: Early years, the life course and health
subtopics.blurb: Explain how early childhood and adversity shape later health, and apply a life course approach from conception to older age.

subtopics.title: Immunology, immunisation and herd immunity
subtopics.blurb: Explain how vaccines create immunity, protect whole populations, and who is offered what under the UKHSA schedule from September 2026.

subtopics.title: Health and safety at work
subtopics.blurb: Apply HASAWA, RIDDOR, COSHH, manual handling rules, LOLER and the Sharps Regulations to everyday nursing.

subtopics.title: Risk assessment and risk management
subtopics.blurb: Use risk tools the way current guidance intends, respond to hazards, and tell positive risk management apart from risk aversion.

subtopics.title: Incidents, PSIRF and learning from harm
subtopics.blurb: Recognise and report near misses, incidents and Never Events, and explain how PSIRF and LFPSE turn them into learning.

subtopics.title: Quality improvement and clinical audit
subtopics.blurb: Use the Model for Improvement, PDSA cycles and the audit cycle, and tell audit apart from service evaluation and research.

subtopics.title: Human factors and safety culture
subtopics.blurb: Explain how the job, the person and the organisation shape error, classify human failure, and build a culture where people speak up.

subtopics.title: Safe staffing and skill mix
subtopics.blurb: Recognise NICE nursing red flags, escalate unsafe staffing and skill mix, and use evidence to make a basic business case.

subtopics.title: Major incidents
subtopics.blurb: Define major, critical and business continuity incidents, give an M/ETHANE report, triage with the NHS MITT and know your role in the response.

subtopics.title: Leadership, management and team culture
subtopics.blurb: Show leadership from any position, build on team strengths, lead change well and influence organisations and policy.

subtopics.title: Prioritisation, delegation and accountability
subtopics.blurb: Prioritise a group of patients, delegate safely within competence with clear instructions, and know who is accountable for what.

subtopics.title: Supervising students and giving feedback
subtopics.blurb: Know the SSSA roles, give clear constructive feedback, record performance well and monitor care given by others and by lay carers.

subtopics.title: Teamwork, conflict and negotiation
subtopics.blurb: Listen to team concerns, stay calm in conflict, confront and de-escalate well, negotiate, advocate and contribute to the team.

subtopics.title: Interagency working and integrated care
subtopics.blurb: Know who does what in the MDT and across agencies, how integrated care systems work in England, and how to join up care for people.

subtopics.title: Health policy, legislation and economics
subtopics.blurb: Explain devolved UK differences, QALYs, cost-effectiveness and opportunity cost, current policy changes, and how nurses influence policy.

subtopics.title: Complex needs, independence and equitable access
subtopics.blurb: Coordinate care for people with complex needs, promote independence, and make reasonable adjustments so everyone can access care.

subtopics.title: Discharge, transfers and carers
subtopics.blurb: Plan safe discharge and transfer using discharge to assess pathways 0–3, NICE NG27 and the duties to involve and assess carers.

subtopics.title: Oxygen as a prescribed drug: target ranges 94-98% and 88-92%
subtopics.blurb: Choose the right saturation target for each adult, spot who is at risk of hypercapnia and know when oximetry misleads you.

subtopics.title: Oxygen delivery devices, titration and weaning
subtopics.blurb: Match the device and flow to the patient, titrate safely against the target and wean oxygen off without rebound hypoxaemia.

subtopics.title: COPD: diagnosis, inhalers, pulmonary rehabilitation and home oxygen
subtopics.blurb: Support an adult with stable COPD through diagnosis, inhaled treatment, rehabilitation, rescue packs and home oxygen decisions.

subtopics.title: Acute exacerbation of COPD
subtopics.blurb: Assess and manage an adult admitted with a COPD exacerbation: gases, controlled oxygen, nebulisers, steroids, NIV and ceilings of care.

subtopics.title: Asthma in adults: diagnosis and AIR/MART treatment
subtopics.blurb: Apply the 2024 BTS/NICE/SIGN asthma guideline: objective diagnosis, ICS/formoterol AIR and MART, technique, adherence and action plans.

subtopics.title: Acute asthma: recognising severity and first actions
subtopics.blurb: Grade an adult asthma attack using SIGN 158 and start the right first treatments: oxygen, nebulised bronchodilators and steroids.

subtopics.title: Hypertension and postural hypotension
subtopics.blurb: Measure blood pressure accurately, confirm hypertension with ABPM or HBPM, know the targets and drug steps, and test for postural hypotension.

subtopics.title: Chronic heart failure
subtopics.blurb: Support an adult with chronic heart failure under NICE NG106 (2025): NT-proBNP referral, the four HFrEF medicines, blood test monitoring, advice and rehabilitation.

subtopics.title: Atrial fibrillation and anticoagulation
subtopics.blurb: Detect atrial fibrillation, score stroke and bleeding risk with CHA2DS2-VASc and ORBIT, and support safe DOAC anticoagulation and rate control.

subtopics.title: Acute coronary syndromes and secondary prevention
subtopics.blurb: Recognise suspected ACS, give the right immediate treatment, understand STEMI reperfusion windows and support secondary prevention and cardiac rehabilitation.

subtopics.title: VTE prevention, DVT and PE
subtopics.blurb: Prevent hospital-acquired VTE under NG89, care safely for people in anti-embolism stockings, and follow the NG158 Wells pathways for suspected DVT and PE.

subtopics.title: Recognising stroke and TIA
subtopics.blurb: Recognise suspected stroke and TIA with FAST and ROSIER, exclude hypoglycaemia, and know NG128 actions: TIA aspirin and 24-hour review, immediate CT and time windows.

subtopics.title: Acute stroke care: thrombolysis, thrombectomy and the first 24 hours
subtopics.blurb: Know the treatment windows, the blood pressure, glucose and oxygen targets, and the nursing care that protects the brain in the first day.

subtopics.title: Dysphagia screening and nutrition after stroke
subtopics.blurb: Keep people safe from aspiration after stroke: screen before anything by mouth, escalate to specialists, and start tube feeding and medicine changes on time.

subtopics.title: Type 1 diabetes: targets, insulin and self-management
subtopics.blurb: Recognise type 1 diabetes, know the NICE NG17 glucose and HbA1c targets, and support safe basal-bolus insulin, injection technique and hypo awareness.

subtopics.title: Type 2 diabetes: targets and the 2026 medicines pathway
subtopics.blurb: Apply the NICE NG28 (2026) HbA1c targets and the new first-line medicines: metformin plus an SGLT-2 inhibitor, adding semaglutide in cardiovascular disease.

subtopics.title: Hypoglycaemia in hospital
subtopics.blurb: Treat hypoglycaemia in hospital the JBDS way: pick the right algorithm for the person's conscious level, recheck on time, follow up, and keep the next insulin dose.

subtopics.title: DKA and HHS
subtopics.blurb: Confirm DKA with D, K and A, run the fixed-rate insulin infusion, fluids and potassium safely, and tell DKA apart from the slower, more dangerous-to-rush HHS.

subtopics.title: Sick-day rules, SGLT-2 safety and the diabetic foot
subtopics.blurb: Teach which medicines to pause when someone is dehydrated, spot euglycaemic DKA on SGLT-2 inhibitors, and examine and refer the diabetic foot on time.

subtopics.title: Acute kidney injury
subtopics.blurb: Spot people at risk, recognise AKI from creatinine and urine output, and take the nursing actions NICE NG148 expects: dipstick, fluid balance, medicines review and escalation.

subtopics.title: Chronic kidney disease
subtopics.blurb: Classify CKD by eGFR and ACR, set the right blood pressure target, monitor ACE inhibitors safely, and know when to refer, using NICE NG203.

subtopics.title: Upper GI bleeding
subtopics.blurb: Recognise and resuscitate an upper GI bleed, use the Blatchford and Rockall scores, and apply NICE CG141 on transfusion, endoscopy timing, PPIs and variceal bleeding.

subtopics.title: The acute abdomen: nursing assessment and first actions
subtopics.blurb: Assess sudden severe abdominal pain systematically, give analgesia early, spot the red flags of a surgical emergency, and know the NICE rules for pancreatitis and ruptured aneurysm.

subtopics.title: Preparing for surgery: assessment, fasting and diabetes
subtopics.blurb: Prepare adults for surgery safely: modern fasting times, carbohydrate drinks, prehabilitation, preoperative checks, and the JBDS rules for people with diabetes.

subtopics.title: Enhanced recovery and postoperative pain
subtopics.blurb: Explain an enhanced recovery programme and choose, give and review multimodal analgesia the way NICE NG180 sets out.

subtopics.title: Recognising postoperative complications
subtopics.blurb: Spot bleeding, hypothermia, low urine output, wound infection, VTE risk and delirium after surgery, and act on each.

topics.title: The Older Person, Multimorbidity & Cancer Care

subtopics.title: Frailty: recognising and assessing it
subtopics.blurb: Score the Clinical Frailty Scale on the right baseline and choose the NICE NG56 frailty tool that fits the setting.

subtopics.title: Falls prevention and care after a fall
subtopics.blurb: Apply NICE NG249 to decide who gets a comprehensive falls assessment, what it includes, and how to act after a fall with a head injury.

subtopics.title: Delirium: prevention, 4AT and management
subtopics.blurb: Spot people at risk, prevent delirium with a tailored bundle, score the 4AT correctly and manage delirium safely.

subtopics.title: Person-centred dementia care
subtopics.blurb: Coordinate person-centred dementia care, respond to distress by finding its cause, and know NICE NG97's limits on antipsychotics and other medicines.

subtopics.title: Polypharmacy, deprescribing and STOPP/START
subtopics.blurb: Recognise problematic polypharmacy, apply the NICE medicine-count thresholds and support a structured review that stops, starts and safely withdraws medicines.

subtopics.title: Multimorbidity and complex care coordination
subtopics.blurb: Use the NICE NG56 approach to reduce treatment burden around the person's goals, and coordinate safe transitions between hospital and home.

subtopics.title: Continence promotion in adults
subtopics.blurb: Categorise urinary incontinence, assess it properly and start the NICE NG123 first-line treatments, so pads are never the plan.

subtopics.title: Chronic pain and long-term conditions
subtopics.blurb: Tell chronic primary from chronic secondary pain, assess its impact on the person's life and support the NICE NG193 treatments that help.

subtopics.title: Neutropenic sepsis
subtopics.blurb: Suspect neutropenic sepsis early, give empiric antibiotics without delay and follow NICE CG151 from confirmation to discharge.

subtopics.title: Oncology emergencies: MSCC and others
subtopics.blurb: Recognise metastatic spinal cord compression early, act on NICE NG234's time frames, and spot hypercalcaemia and other cancer emergencies.

subtopics.title: Decimals and place value: moving the point, leading zeros and tenfold errors
subtopics.blurb: Read every digit's true value, move the decimal point the right number of places, and write doses so they cannot be misread tenfold.

subtopics.title: Mass conversions: kg, g, mg, micrograms and nanograms
subtopics.blurb: Convert confidently between kg, g, mg, micrograms and nanograms, knowing which way the point moves and why a mg/microgram slip is a thousandfold error.

subtopics.title: Volume conversions: L and mL
subtopics.blurb: Convert between litres and millilitres in both directions, add mixed volumes safely and type the answer in the unit the box asks for.

subtopics.title: Units, international units and millimoles on labels and prescriptions
subtopics.blurb: Work with doses in units and millimoles from the strength on the label, write "units" safely and enter the answer in the right box.

subtopics.title: Time: hours and minutes, the 24-hour clock and finish times
subtopics.blurb: Convert between hours and minutes, use the 24-hour clock, and work out infusion durations and finish times, including across midnight.

subtopics.title: Percentages, fractions and ratio strengths (% w/v, 1 in 1,000)
subtopics.blurb: Turn % w/v and "1 in" ratio strengths into grams, milligrams and micrograms per mL, and work out percentages of a dose.

subtopics.title: Reading a graduated syringe: scale intervals and where to read the plunger
subtopics.blurb: Work out what each small mark on any syringe is worth, read the volume at the right edge of the plunger seal and type it in Pearson format.

subtopics.title: Reading a medicine pot or oral measure
subtopics.blurb: Work out the scale on a medicine pot, read the bottom of the meniscus at eye level and record the volume dispensed in Pearson format.

subtopics.title: Choosing the right syringe or measure for the volume
subtopics.blurb: Pick the smallest syringe or measure that holds the whole dose and is marked finely enough to measure it exactly.

subtopics.title: The core formula: what you want over what you have, times the volume
subtopics.blurb: Use want ÷ have x volume for liquids and want ÷ have for tablets, with units matched first and rounding left to the end.

subtopics.title: Reading strengths from labels: mg/5 mL, mg in 1 mL, mg/2 mL, units/mL
subtopics.blurb: Read what a label's strength really means, find the amount per mL or per container, and pick the right numbers for want ÷ have.

subtopics.title: Number of tablets for a prescribed dose
subtopics.blurb: Work out how many tablets make one prescribed dose, check it makes sense, and type it the way Pearson marks it.

subtopics.title: Tablets when prescription and stock use different units (g, mg, micrograms)
subtopics.blurb: Convert the prescription and the stock into the same unit, then work out the tablets without a thousandfold slip.

subtopics.title: Half tablets: only when the stem says the tablet is scored
subtopics.blurb: Give half tablets when, and only when, the tablet is scored, and type answers such as 1.5 and 0.5 correctly.

subtopics.title: Daily totals from frequency: BD, TDS, QDS and hourly intervals
subtopics.blurb: Turn a dose and a frequency into a 24-hour total in mg, g or tablets without mixing up intervals and counts.

subtopics.title: Oral liquid volumes from mg/5 mL and mg/1 mL
subtopics.blurb: Calculate the volume of an oral liquid from its label strength, including the stock volume, and give it to the decimal places asked.

subtopics.title: Liquids when the prescription is in g or micrograms and the label in mg
subtopics.blurb: Convert a g or microgram prescription to match a mg label, then calculate the liquid volume without a thousandfold error.

subtopics.title: Weight-based oral doses: mg/kg and micrograms/kg then volume
subtopics.blurb: Turn a mg/kg or micrograms/kg prescription into a dose, then into a volume or a number of tablets.

subtopics.title: Checking a dose against a stated maximum or dose range
subtopics.blurb: Compare a prescribed dose or daily total with a stated maximum or range, and work out what can still safely be given.

subtopics.title: Volume to draw up from an ampoule (mg in 1 mL, mg in 2 mL)
subtopics.blurb: Read an ampoule label correctly and calculate the volume to draw up, whether the strength is per 1 mL, per 2 mL or in micrograms.

subtopics.title: Weight-based injections: mg/kg to mL to one or two decimal places
subtopics.blurb: Turn a mg/kg or micrograms/kg prescription into a dose, then into the exact volume to draw up, rounded the way the stem asks.

subtopics.title: Doses in units: insulin U100, heparin, enoxaparin and nystatin
subtopics.blurb: Handle doses written in units: convert units to mL from the label, and keep units and mL apart.

subtopics.title: Reconstitution, displacement and final concentration
subtopics.blurb: Add the powder's displacement to the diluent, find the final concentration, then draw up the right volume.

subtopics.title: Emergency volumes: IM adrenaline 1 mg/mL by age band, buccal and IV anticonvulsants
subtopics.blurb: Turn adrenaline micrograms into mL from a 1 mg/mL ampoule, and calculate buccal and intravenous anticonvulsant volumes from the strength given.

subtopics.title: Pump rate in mL per hour from a prescription chart
subtopics.blurb: Read a prescription chart row and set an infusion pump in mL per hour, including infusions over minutes.

subtopics.title: Pump rates that need rounding to the nearest whole number
subtopics.blurb: Round pump rates correctly: half-up, at the very end, to exactly the places the stem asks for.

subtopics.title: Gravity drip rates in drops per minute (drop factor 20, 15 or 60)
subtopics.blurb: Calculate a gravity drip rate in drops per minute using the drop factor given, with time in minutes.

subtopics.title: Infusion duration, volume infused so far and finish time
subtopics.blurb: Work out how long an infusion will take, when it will finish, and how much has gone in or is left.

subtopics.title: Dose-based infusions: mg/h, units/h and micrograms/kg/min to mL/h
subtopics.blurb: Convert a dose per hour, or a dose per kg per minute, into a pump rate in mL per hour using the bag's concentration.

subtopics.title: Completing a 24-hour fluid balance chart: total input and total output
